ctx.stageWhatRecall: brings archived content back into the context on demand
ctx.stageWhatSweep: replaces old tool output with a summary + placeholder; the original history stays in the session file
ctx.stagesTip: The three working-set stages: Sweep replaces old tool output with a summary (70%), Fold turns finished work into a conclusion (85%), Compact compresses the whole conversation (100%). Dashed stages are not wired up yet and will not fire.
ctx.tip:
Used {used} / limit {win} ({pct}%)
Turns amber at 85%, red at 95% — auto-compaction kicks in before it fills
ctx.tipWorkingSet:
Working set used {used} / cap {cap} ({pct}%) — compacts at the line
The meter's denominator is the physical window {win} (pi's native compaction line stays as a fallback)
ctx.workingSetTip: The effective limit derived from min(240k, window×70%, window−reserve−margin); at this line the app asks pi to compact — far earlier than the physical window

set.alwaysOnTopDesc: When on, the window stays above everything else and will cover other apps. Same switch as the pin button in the title bar
set.ctxCapDesc: Yan compacts once the context reaches this many tokens. Default 240000 (~240k)
set.ctxHint: Leave empty to use the default. Changes apply immediately, no restart
set.ctxModelDesc: Overrides only for {model}; other models keep their own values
set.ctxModelPresetDesc: Writes only to this exact model; verify endpoint capacity and output budget first — still needs measurement
set.ctxModelPresetUnavailable: This model has no clear large-window registration; use the fields below and verify it yourself
set.ctxModelHint: Leave empty and save to remove this model override
set.ctxModelNoModel: No current model yet (available once connected)
set.ctxPresetDesc: The reference preset only changes the cap and window ratio; the stages stay Yan’s three, no extra stages appear
set.ctxRatioDesc: The working set never exceeds this share of the model window. Default 0.7
set.ctxReserveDesc: Space kept for the model answer. Default 32000; small windows are lowered by formula
set.ctxSource.off: Auto compaction is off — the working-set view does not apply
set.deepDescOff: Off (default): answers use the context as-is. When on, Yan runs one extra call after you ask and before the model answers, condensing "where this task stands right now" into a short brief inserted into the context — useful for cross-file debugging and long sessions. It costs up to 30s of extra waiting per turn plus one extra call. It only kicks in when the context is long, and only once per question. Takes effect immediately.
set.deepDescOn: On: one extra summarization call after each question, before the model answers (up to 30s of extra waiting). It only runs when the context exceeds 150k tokens, and only once per question. Turn it off here if it feels slow or spends too much quota — takes effect immediately.
set.defaultWorkModeDesc: Applies to new sessions only; each existing session keeps its own mode, changeable next to the input (Tab cycles)
set.densityDesc: Changes spacing only — never font size (Chinese glyphs are pixel-aligned at 12.5px). Standard is identical to before.
set.foldDescOff: Off: no task state is generated, and none is put into the context. State files already written stay in the local data directory (they are not deleted) and are picked up again if you turn this back on. Takes effect immediately.
set.foldDescOn: On by default: once the context is long enough and the turn actually changed something, Yan runs one extra call after the turn to write down where the task stands (files touched, commands run, open items, conclusions), and puts that state before the history on the next turn — less likely to lose the thread in cross-file debugging and long sessions. Short sessions and read-only turns do not trigger it. Turn it off here to save quota; takes effect immediately.
set.knDeleteAsk: A deleted entry leaves the search set. Logical delete keeps the text and can be restored; permanent delete leaves a tombstone without text (old candidates cannot come back).
set.knDescOff: Off: no search, no injection, no candidates. Saved entries stay put; you can turn it back on anytime.
set.knDescOn: Before answering, the app searches this project’s confirmed knowledge for the current question (up to 8 entries / 2k tokens) and passes it along as sourced material. Nothing is injected when nothing matches.
set.knEmpty: No entries yet. What the model proposes with `yan knowledge propose` shows up under “Pending”.
set.knExportHint: Exports the current state (deleted entries excluded); copy it or save to a file. It never rewrites docs in the repo.
set.knExportManual: Clipboard unavailable: the text is in the editor above, copy it manually
set.knNoProject: This session has no project working directory, so project knowledge is unavailable. Start a session inside a project first.
set.knReplaceHint: Write a new entry that replaces this one. The old one is kept as “Superseded” (history stays readable).
set.langDesc: Affects the UI only. Replies and tool output pass through untouched
set.logsDesc: Last {n} lines (extension notices and pi stderr)
